## DelphiGenAI

**Project:** DelphiGenAI  
**Author / maintainer:** MaxiDonkey  
**Repository:** https://github.com/MaxiDonkey/DelphiGenAI  
**License:** MIT License  
**Copyright:** Copyright (c) 2024-2026 MaxiDonkey

DelphiGenAI is an open source Delphi wrapper for the OpenAI API.

It provides Delphi-native access to OpenAI's Messages API, including features such as synchronous and asynchronous execution, SSE streaming, tool/function calling, structured outputs, multimodal inputs, and advanced reasoning modes.

Pythia-Webview2 uses code from DelphiGenAI to integrate or demonstrate OpenAI API interactions from Delphi applications.

### Bundled copy

The version of DelphiGenAI included in this repository may not be the latest upstream version.

It is provided primarily to make the examples easier to compile and to improve the first-run experience for developers discovering Pythia-Webview2.

For production projects, it is recommended to clone or download DelphiGenAI directly from the official upstream repository, then add its source path to the Delphi project options.

### Relationship with OpenAI

DelphiGenAI is an unofficial library.

It is not authored, maintained, endorsed, or supported by OpenAI. OpenAI does not provide an official Delphi SDK for OpenAI.

Users and integrators should refer to OpenAI's official documentation, API terms, and usage policies when using the OpenAI API.
